about: Owner-approved data fixes. Applied on every rebuild. Never add an entry without the owner's yes.

fixes.problem: Career Record and Career WP% cells are stale (CLEV 41-11, OHIO 46-21, M-OH 51-19).
fixes.replacement: Career W, L and win % are computed by summing the season rows (2024 onward) for each program.

fixes.problem: 2034 B12-CH row lists OHIO vs M-OH 57-42 (M-OH). Conference Champions and the coach sheet (15-2) show CLEV played M-OH.
2029 table: 'B12' row holds BUFF vs MASS and 'MAC' row holds CLEV vs M-OH.
Sam Fatafehi receiving: 13 catches for 2,219 yards with a 44-yard long (impossible).

fixes.owner_words: use the CFB playoff tree to help determine scores and champions for the playoffs
fixes.problem: Schedule rows for games CLEV wasn't in conflict with other sheets (2027 title game shows M-OH beating BAMA 0-0).

set.playoff_games_scores_champions_rounds: CFB Playoff Tree (all teams, all seasons)

fixes.notes: Playoff round names come from the bracket (first round / quarterfinal / semifinal / final), not the Schedule's RD 1/RD 2/RD 3 labels, which count CLEV's own games and skip byes.

fixes.batch: F06-F11 approved together by the owner
fixes.problem: Final Score is usually winner-first but sometimes CLEV-first (2031 title game '34-35').
fixes.set: Parse both numbers; assign the larger to the winner given by the result column; store clev_score and opp_score. Strip stray spaces (e.g. ' 56-38 ').

fixes.batch: F06-F11 approved together by the owner
fixes.problem: Result column holds W/L in early seasons and the winning team's abbreviation later.
fixes.set: W if the value is W or CLEV; L if it is L or any other team abbreviation.

fixes.batch: F06-F11 approved together by the owner
fixes.problem: 2024-26 B12-CH and NC rows hold N/A opponents and 0-0 scores.
fixes.set: Skip any Schedule row whose opponent is N/A or whose score is 0-0 with result N/A.

fixes.batch: F06-F11 approved together by the owner
fixes.problem: Table titles name the wrong season in places (2026 tab says 2025, 2035 says 20235, 2037 says 2036, others blank).
fixes.set: The season of every stats row comes from the tab name 'YYYY Stats'. Table title cells are ignored.

fixes.batch: F06-F11 approved together by the owner
fixes.problem: #DIV/0! and #REF! cells.
fixes.set: Treat any #DIV/0!, #REF!, #N/A, #VALUE! cell as blank. Recompute averages (YPC, YPG, YPA, COMP %, WP%) from their inputs when the inputs exist and the divisor is above zero.

fixes.batch: F06-F11 approved together by the owner
fixes.problem: Numbers stored as text ('3,817', '1,085') and records as text ('(5-4)').
fixes.set: Strip commas and spaces and convert to numbers; parse '(W-L)' into conference wins and losses; parse ordinals ('5th', '9TH') into numbers while keeping the display form.

fixes.problem: Records sheet has 21 records, newest 2029; several have since been beaten in the stats tabs.

set.official_records: Records sheet shown exactly as entered (names still pass through aliases.json), labeled 'Official Records'.
set.computed_bests: Separate CLEV list 'Season & Career Bests (computed from the season stats)': single-season and career totals for passing, rushing, receiving and kicking, built only from the stats tabs.
set.record_watch: 2038 Record Watch measures returning players against the computed CLEV list and, where they apply, the official NCAA / Big 12 records.

fixes.problem: Summary rows for 2029-2031 are copies of the 2025 numbers; 2026-28 say 'did not track'; CLEV 2025 summary (2/8/13) differs from the recruit list (2/6/11).

set.clev_star_counts: Counted from the CLEV recruit lists for every recruiting cycle.
set.national_class_rank: Shown for CLEV, M-OH and OHIO for 2024 and 2025 only (rows 41-43, columns C-H and K-P).
set.ignored: Summary blocks for 2029, 2030, 2031 (rows 44-46) and the 'did not track' cells.

fixes.problem: 2026 recruiting block (columns Q-V) has an empty Stars column for all 17 recruits.
fixes.set: stars = null with display 'Not tracked' for the 2026 cycle; exclude the 2026 class from star-count totals. National rank, position and state still shown. Never estimate stars from rank.

fixes.problem: 2025 transfer block (columns J-N) holds numbers (1, 50, 74, 80, 91, 158) in the Class column.
fixes.set: Hide those numbers; class = null with display 'Not recorded' for the six 2025 transfers.

fixes.problem: 2034 MAC #2 lists ECU (an AAC team also listed AAC #4). The 2034 MAC title game was EMU vs BUFF, and every other season's MAC title game matches Standings #1 and #2.

Ratings exist only 2024-32; 2038 block is an in-progress projected chart that still lists 4 players from the 2037 Graduates list; 2039+ blocks are copies of 2024; bold/italic markers are inconsistent.

set.projected_2038: 2038 block = Projected 2038 depth chart. Players also on the latest Graduates list get a 'departing' flag (at approval: Dom Iverson, Wade Luter, Simon Banks, Sammy Haddad).
set.ignored: Every block after the next season (2039+ at approval); bold and italic formatting.
set.status_sources: 90+ comes from the ratings or the Graduates Ovr; drafted status comes from the Graduates sheet.

fixes.problem: Class labels vary in punctuation and a few hold the wrong value.

set.general: Store year (FR/SO/JR/SR) plus redshirt true/false; display as 'SR (RS)'. Accept missing dash ('Dave Shelley SO (RS)'), missing bracket ('JR (RS'), stray spaces.

overrides.evidence: Same season tackle-leader cell and 2036 Graduates: SR (RS)

fixes.problem: Sheets use different position systems (LE/ROLB/FS vs EDGE/LB/S; HB vs RB).

set.position: Kept exactly as entered and shown on cards and depth charts.
set.used_for: Search filters, leaderboards and the games.

fixes.problem: 2035 national title score written '73*' for M-OH.
fixes.set: Read as 73. Show M-OH 73, CLEV 70 with no footnote or OT label.
fixes.owner_words: the asterisk was due to some funky stuff happening in-game, but besides it being sour grapes for me, it has no other meaning

fixes.problem: 2023 All-American RB Ollie Gordon III listed at ORST; the 2023 Walker Award lists him at OKST.
Career records for Baraka Nwangwu and Kenny Tongues were entered partway through 2029 and never updated; they are lower than the sum of the players' own season stats.
Five 2029 receiving rows had the yards pasted into the REC column (catches = yards).
fixes.source: Owner supplied the real catch counts from the game (screenshot, 2026-10-27).

fixes.problem: 2029 Big 12 finish: coach sheets said CLEV 2nd / OHIO 3rd; the Conference Standings block says OHIO 2nd / CLEV 3rd.
fixes.decision: Owner: keep the standings (OHIO 2nd, CLEV 3rd); coach-sheet ranks follow.

fixes.problem: Nine Cleveland State season/career records on the Records sheet stopped being updated around 2029; the stats tabs show they were broken later.
fixes.scope: Cleveland State season and career records only. Single-game, Big 12 and NCAA records stay as entered.
